tests.negative: Original EUR minor units and source-backed incomplete effort/margin stay unknown; ordinary operator cannot read financial controls

tests.positive: UX-05 governance keeps evidenced readiness, exact recovery receipts and role-specific economics
tests.negative: All thirteen missing dimensions block approval; a real observation expires and effective status returns BLOCKED while its historical PASS remains labelled

tests.baseline: Exact configuration preview and independent decision
tests.implementation: Existing bounded JSON, proposal and service commands plus draft guard
tests.positive: UX-05 governance keeps evidenced readiness, exact recovery receipts and role-specific economics
tests.negative: Cancelling scope replacement preserves the draft; own proposal cannot be published; existing operations integration test requires independent exact publication

tests.implementation: Immutable pending command, safe request reference, explicit original-command retry
tests.positive: UX-05 governance keeps evidenced readiness, exact recovery receipts and role-specific economics
tests.negative: Interrupt after actual commit, retry identical JSON/ID, deny closure without source and retain original current case before evidenced resolution

tests.implementation: Per-form retained command and received-versus-refresh feedback
tests.positive: governed SDK fixture review and mobile non-member execution preserve independent rewards and offline retries
tests.negative: Lost response replays original payload/ID; definitive pre-intent rejection allows correction only after complete authorized read; recorded input-size rejection creates no inference attempt; acknowledged review survives refresh outage

tests.implementation: Per-form original command and unchanged exact-assignee/version/independence gates
tests.positive: governed SDK fixture review and mobile non-member execution preserve independent rewards and offline retries
tests.negative: Actual independent operator decision interrupted after commit replays identically; original non-member, suspension, reward-once and compensation negatives remain required

tests.implementation: Mounted original reviewed policy/member controls and focused disclosure access
tests.positive: invited operator enrolls MFA, records provenance, manages flags and signs out
tests.negative: New ordinary-operator workspace lacks owner control/policy/audit UI and actual controls/write APIs deny 403; existing fresh-MFA and two-tenant negatives remain required

limitations: Static native-control parity does not prove every dynamic action/state.
Original programme rows without direct executed linkage remain NOT_YET_VERIFIED.
